notes.title: BOT Players Added!
notes.notes: When the game was first published, you needed to have at least 2 human players to play. Now, one player can play against one or multiple BOT players! Or 2 or 3 humans can add additional players! Or just put in all BOTs and see who wins!

notes.title: Released!
notes.notes: The game is now ready! Enjoy!
